description: List and download attachments for a message. When saveDir is omitted, attachments are written to pippin's cache directory (~/Library/Caches/pippin/attachments/<msg>/) and the paths are returned in `savedPath`; the agent can then read the files with its file tools.

expectMessageId.description: Optional RFC Message-ID the id must still name: a row's messageIdHeader (request it with fields). On mismatch nothing happens and the error code is message_identity_mismatch.

messageId.description: Compound message ID from mail_list or mail_show output.

saveDir.description: Optional directory to save attachments into. If omitted, a pippin cache directory is used.

title: mail_attachments: arguments
